name: clinica-dwi-preprocessing-using-t1
description:
Preprocessing of raw DWI datasets using a T1w image.

https://aramislab.paris.inria.fr/clinica/docs/public/latest/Pipelines/DWI_Preprocessing/

inputs.description: Define the b0 volumes as all volume bval <= low_bval. (Default: 5)
inputs.name: low_bval

inputs.description: TSV file containing a list of subjects with their sessions.
inputs.name: subjects_sessions_tsv

inputs.description: Temporary directory to store pipelines intermediate results.
inputs.name: working_directory

inputs.description: Number of cores used to run in parallel.
inputs.name: n_procs

inputs.description: Use the CUDA implementation of FSL eddy. See https://fsl.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fslwiki/eddy/UsersGuide#The_eddy_executables for details.
inputs.name: use_cuda

inputs.description: Initialize the random number generator used when estimating hyperparameters in FSL eddy.
inputs.name: initrand

inputs.description: If True, large intermediary files will be deleted before the end of the pipeline.
inputs.name: delete_cache

inputs.description: Specify the random seed for algorithms that support it.
inputs.name: random_seed

inputs.description: The name of the CAPS dataset that will be created by the pipeline. This is not the name of the folder itself, but the name in the metadata, which can be different if desired. If the CAPS folder already exists and already has a name, this will have no effect and the existing name will be kept.
inputs.name: caps_name
